decisions.decision: Use local ComfyUI + SDXL 1.0 base (free, OpenRAIL++-M commercial-safe license) instead of Midjourney (no free tier, no API) or a paid image-gen API
decisions.rationale: Zero cost, already matches PROVENANCE.json's recorded checkpoint, Codex/cloud agents can't reach a local server anyway so generation had to happen in this session

decisions.decision: Abhimanyu's approved reference sheet does NOT depict the gilded eye-mask on the main figure
decisions.rationale: 5 generation rounds + 1 inpaint attempt showed mask-presence and full-body/correct-limb framing consistently trading off against each other. Mask repurposed as a future gameplay mechanic instead (see SEED-001).

decisions.decision: Planted SEED-001: masked stealth/regen alt-stance with weaker/slower attacks, for Phase 4 (Gameplay Depth)
decisions.rationale: Turns the discarded mask art direction into new design scope rather than losing the idea

decisions.decision: img2img from a border-cropped version of the locked reference (assets/sprites/reference/_derived/abhimanyu-char-base.png), NOT fresh txt2img per frame, is the working technique for LOW-pose-change animation frames (idle)
decisions.rationale: Fresh txt2img per frame produced wildly inconsistent character/outfit/weapon (tested via a failed 2x2 grid 'sprite sheet in one image' attempt); low-denoise (0.35) img2img from the same base image preserved identity/outfit/sword near-perfectly across 4 frames

decisions.decision: Use rembg (u2net model) for background removal, not naive color-distance thresholding
decisions.rationale: The generated art has a subtle vignette/gradient background, not a flat color -- simple corner-color-distance thresholding left a visible halo/arch-shaped fringe around the character. rembg's semantic segmentation cleanly removed it with no fringe.
